text:
I hear that you and your pet Finn were impacted by a delayed departure during your journey, and you are frustrated about the disruption and the way the situation played out for you and your travel plans.

First, I want to acknowledge how stressful it is when travel does not go as expected, especially when a companion animal is involved. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk treats these moments as a shared responsibility, and we aim to communicate with respect and clarity while the crew works through the situation.

For the specific incident type you described, the standard payout applies as outlined in our policy: <<FACT F109>>. If you have not already submitted the required details, you can do so through the claim process, and the team will review what happened step by step, keeping the focus on your pet’s welfare and on the facts of the disruption.

Regarding timing for the filing window, <<FACT F116>>. If you are within that window, please send your claim as soon as you can so we can get it into the review flow without delays. If you are unsure whether your submission falls within the allowed period, let us know what dates you are working with and we will guide you on the next steps.

We also want to share what typically helps during the internal review. Please include any information you have about your travel itinerary, the reason you were given at the time, and any notes about when Finn was handled or affected during the delay. Our process includes practical instructions shared with crews, and having clear context helps the senior coordinator and the review team verify whether everything followed the correct procedures.

If your experience also included a missed connection while on the same travel day, mention that in your message as well. That ensures we route your file properly from the start and do not ask you to repeat details later.

We are sorry again for the frustration this caused, and we appreciate you taking the time to reach out. Aurelia Skyways is here to make things right where we can, and we will work calmly and promptly with you to bring this to a fair outcome.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
